steps.text: Old notes out ↔ replacement notes in
No exact shares • no guaranteed fixed rate
Old name ≠ always fiat; ranking needs a measure
Demand > supply → purchasing power may fall
Limited: compulsory up to amount; optional beyond
Unlimited ≠ permission for every cash transaction
Limit is an amount, not 1,000 coins
Price: demand–supply, not state fixed-value promise
Collector price ≠ debt settlement ≠ compulsory limit
Acceptance does not confer fiat or legal-tender status
